title: Flow Undo and Redo Shortcuts
description: Add ctrl+z / ctrl+y undo/redo for flow canvas. Implement history stack in FlowHost (Rust core), expose via WASM FlowSession, bind native keyboard shortcuts in React FlowCanvas.
summary: Added undo/redo history stack to FlowHost in the Rust core. Snapshots fixture content (widgets, synapses, layout) while ignoring camera/view changes. Discrete mutations call begin_change(); pointer gestures coalesce into single steps via pending snapshot on pointer down and commit on pointer up. Exposed undo/redo/canUndo/canRedo on FlowSession WASM bindings. Wired native keyboard shortcuts in FlowCanvas: Cmd/Ctrl+Z undo, Cmd/Ctrl+Y and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z redo. Added Rust unit tests and vitest coverage. Rebuilt WASM and verified all tests pass.
